description: Private retained SHA-224/256 SHA-NI component, explicit version-13 decoder and lifetime-bound in-page placement. Real hardened kernels tested in ordinary Linux and Windows processes, not in an enclave image. No shipping Rust or release-gate change.

placement_model.scope: Actual placement/destruction source; explicit non-cryptographic authority/owner lifetime doubles with alignment and padding. Narrowed provenance and overlapping slots cause Miri UB rejection; reversed destruction trips the lifetime assertion. Not cryptographic, native OS or enclave evidence.

limitations: Source overlay on Windows, not an exact native Git checkout; captured source hashes verified locally
Only SHA-224 and SHA-256 accepted; no wide/general SHA-2 or scalar fallback
No feature-checked enclave entry, trusted image binding or host-session API for this route yet
Page placement does not establish residency or protected worker-stack admission
Miri lifetime doubles do not exercise real owner internals or inline-assembly kernels
Integrated ABI/register/stack, dump/failure and independent-review qualification still pending
